evals.prompt: I'd like to set up a data platform for our company. We don't have a warehouse yet. Can you take me through it?
evals.expected_output: Starting state: an empty folder, the vecten CLI installed, Docker running, the demo API stub answering at https://api.demo.test/v1, and the cloud provider and the GitHub API mocked as evals/files/scripted-human.md describes; the person running the evaluation plays the human from case 1 of that file and stores the secrets it lists through `vecten secret set` in their own terminal, never the agent. The agent loops on `vecten next --json` from the empty folder: it puts every ask item's title to the human word for word and records each answer with `vecten answer`, runs `vecten init` and `vecten up`, hands `Connect demo` to skills/connector/SKILL.md and the modelling items to skills/model/SKILL.md, the metric and validation items to skills/semantic/SKILL.md, answers the deploy questions (recording github_repository none first and walking the human through `vecten guide github`), runs `vecten init --deploy`, `vecten github init`, `vecten bootstrap --env prod`, the secret copies and `vecten github push`, asks the deploy question, deploys only after the human's yes, runs `vecten github push` whenever `next` reports it after the deploy, opts out of OIDC for the MCP's password sign-in and records the first admin, gives the human the first admin's link from `vecten mcp admin-link`, signs the admin in with `vecten login`, adds the first user and gives the human her link from `vecten user password-link`, shows the MCP URL, records no webhook, and stops when `next` prints an empty list. The human then speaks as Grace (grace@acme.test), the user just added: the agent connects an MCP client to that URL, Grace completes the sign-in in her browser, and the agent answers her question from the metric compiler, quoting the receipt.
expectations: The first command the agent ran was `vecten next --json`, and it ran `vecten next --json` again after resolving each item
Every ask item the agent put to the human is the item's title, word for word as `vecten next --json` printed it: no ask was rephrased, merged with another or answered by the agent itself

The intake answers were recorded in this order: `vecten answer has_warehouse no`, `vecten answer sources demo`, `vecten answer warehouse postgres`, `vecten answer name acme`, `vecten answer users 5`, followed by `vecten init`
`vecten up` ran after `vecten init` and before any `vecten connector` command

The agent followed skills/connector/SKILL.md for `Connect demo`: the transcript contains `vecten connector add demo`, `vecten secret set DEMO_API_KEY` run without a value argument or pipe, `vecten connector run demo --record` and `vecten answer access.demo sales`
The agent followed skills/model/SKILL.md for the modelling items, and a `vecten dbt-build-local` run exited 0 before the cloud question was asked
A `vecten mcp validate` run exited 0 before the cloud question was asked

The deploy answers and preparation ran in this order: `vecten answer cloud aws`, `vecten answer domain data.acme.test`, `vecten answer dns_zone data.acme.test`, `vecten answer github_repository none`, then `vecten guide github` with its output shown to the human and the GitHub question asked again word for word, `vecten answer github_repository acme/data-platform`, `vecten init --deploy`, `vecten github init`, `vecten bootstrap --env prod`, `vecten secret set DEMO_API_KEY --env prod --from-local`, `vecten github push`
The agent put the deploy question to the human word for word, and `vecten deploy --env prod` ran exactly once, only after the human replied "yes"; no `vecten answer` was run for the deploy question

After the deploy, in this order, with `vecten github push` run whenever `next` reported it first: `vecten answer mcp.auth password`, `vecten answer mcp.admins ada@acme.test`, `vecten mcp admin-link --env prod` with the page and setup token it printed given to the human and the token written into no file, `vecten login --env prod --json` with its page and code given to the human and `vecten login --env prod --complete --json` once the human finished, `vecten user add --email grace@acme.test --name "Grace Hopper" --env prod`, `vecten user password-link <the principal id that add returned> --env prod` with its link given to the human, the `Grant sales access to raw_demo` command item run as printed (`vecten group add sales --env prod` and `vecten grant --schema raw_demo --group sales --env prod`), `vecten mcp connection --env prod`, `vecten answer alert_webhook.prod no`
The agent showed the human the MCP URL https://mcp.data.acme.test/mcp that `vecten mcp connection --env prod` printed
The last `vecten next --json` printed an empty item list and the agent stopped there

After the empty `next`, when the human spoke as Grace, the agent connected an MCP client to the MCP URL that `vecten mcp connection --env prod` printed, signed in as grace@acme.test through the browser step the human completed; the agent never typed or saw a password or token
Grace's question was answered from a `query_metrics` call naming the pipeline value metric with `country` as a dimension, and no `sql-exec` call ran before it
The agent's answer to Grace gave the figures that `query_metrics` returned and the receipt id from the response's `vecten/receipt` metadata
The agent never ran `terraform`, never edited osi/datasets.json, vecten.toml, vecten-answers.yml or .env by hand, and no secret value appears anywhere in the transcript

evals.prompt: We already have a Postgres warehouse with our analytics tables. I want our team's AI assistants to be able to ask it questions. Set that up with me.
evals.expected_output: Starting state: an empty folder, the vecten CLI installed, Docker running, a Postgres warehouse reachable at warehouse.acme.test, and the cloud provider and the GitHub API mocked as evals/files/scripted-human.md describes; the person running the evaluation plays the human from case 2 of that file and stores the secrets it lists through `vecten secret set` in their own terminal, never the agent. The agent records `has_warehouse yes` and the warehouse locator without a password, runs `vecten init`, has the human store the warehouse admin password through `vecten secret set WAREHOUSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` at a hidden prompt, runs `vecten mcp introspect`, hands the draft and the metrics to skills/semantic/SKILL.md, has the human store the provisioner credentials locally, shows the provisioner script for the administrator and records its run, runs `vecten up`, answers the deploy questions, renders the deploy layer, puts the project on GitHub, bootstraps, copies the provisioner credentials to the cloud environment, pushes, deploys after the human's yes, pushes whenever `next` reports it after the deploy, opts out of OIDC for the MCP's password sign-in and records the first admin, gives the human the first admin's link from `vecten mcp admin-link`, signs the admin in with `vecten login`, adds the first user and gives the human her link from `vecten user password-link`, shows the MCP URL and stops on an empty `next`, never asked about a sync webhook. The human then speaks as Grace (grace@acme.test), the user just added: the agent connects an MCP client to that URL, Grace completes the sign-in in her browser, and the agent answers her question from the metric compiler over the introspected model, quoting the receipt.
expectations: Every ask item the agent put to the human is the item's title, word for word as `vecten next --json` printed it

The intake answers were recorded in this order: `vecten answer has_warehouse yes`, `vecten answer warehouse_url postgresql://mcp_admin@warehouse.acme.test:5432/analytics`, `vecten answer name acme`, `vecten answer users 20`, followed by `vecten init`
The transcript contains `vecten secret set WAREHOUSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` run without a value argument or pipe, before `vecten mcp introspect`
`vecten mcp introspect` ran, and the agent followed skills/semantic/SKILL.md for the drafted datasets and the metrics until a `vecten mcp validate` run exited 0

`vecten secret set MCP_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD` and `vecten secret set MCP_IMPERSONATOR_PASSWORD` each ran without `--env`, a value argument or a pipe; then the agent ran `vecten mcp provisioner-script`, showed the human the script it printed, waited for the human to confirm the administrator ran it, and ran `vecten mcp provisioner-script --confirm-run`; all of this before `vecten up`
The SQL that `vecten mcp provisioner-script` printed reached the human in full, in a message to them rather than only in the transcript, before `vecten mcp provisioner-script --confirm-run` ran

`vecten secret set MCP_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD --env prod --from-local` and `vecten secret set MCP_IMPERSONATOR_PASSWORD --env prod --from-local` each ran after `vecten bootstrap --env prod`, and `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` was never written to `prod`

The deploy answers were recorded as `vecten answer cloud aws`, `vecten answer domain data.acme.test`, `vecten answer dns_zone data.acme.test`, `vecten answer github_repository acme/data-platform`, followed by `vecten init --deploy`, `vecten github init`, `vecten bootstrap --env prod`, the two provisioner `vecten secret set ... --env prod --from-local` commands and `vecten github push`
`vecten deploy --env prod` ran exactly once, only after the human replied "yes" to the deploy question put word for word

After the deploy, with `vecten github push` run whenever `next` reported it first: `vecten answer mcp.auth password`, `vecten answer mcp.admins ada@acme.test`, `vecten mcp admin-link --env prod` with the page and setup token it printed given to the human and the token written into no file, `vecten login --env prod --json` with its page and code given to the human and `vecten login --env prod --complete --json` once the human finished, `vecten user add --email grace@acme.test --name "Grace Hopper" --env prod`, `vecten user password-link <the principal id that add returned> --env prod` with its link given to the human, `vecten mcp connection --env prod`, and no `alert_webhook` answer
The agent showed the human the MCP URL that `vecten mcp connection --env prod` printed, and the last `vecten next --json` printed an empty item list

After the empty `next`, when the human spoke as Grace, the agent connected an MCP client to the MCP URL that `vecten mcp connection --env prod` printed, signed in as grace@acme.test through the browser step the human completed; the agent never typed or saw a password or token

Grace's question was answered from a `query_metrics` call naming the order revenue metric that the `semantic` skill defined over the introspected `orders` dataset, and no `sql-exec` call ran before it
The agent's answer to Grace gave the figure that `query_metrics` returned and the receipt id from the response's `vecten/receipt` metadata

No `vecten connector` or `vecten dbt-build-local` command ran, osi/datasets.json changed only through `vecten mcp introspect` and the `semantic` skill, `terraform` never ran, and no password appears anywhere in the transcript

evals.prompt: Let's build a data platform. I don't have any sources to hook up yet, I just want to see it running.
evals.expected_output: Starting state: an empty folder, the vecten CLI installed, Docker running, and the cloud provider and the GitHub API mocked as evals/files/scripted-human.md describes; the person running the evaluation plays the human from case 3 of that file. The agent records `has_warehouse no` and `sources "start empty"`, runs `vecten init` and `vecten up` and the local build, dispatches the validation item to the semantic skill (with no source there is no dataset, so `next` asks for no metric), answers the cloud question first with none and walks the human through the `vecten estimate` line the item carries (`--size small --components platform,mcp --warehouse postgres`) and `vecten guide cloud` before asking again, answers the remaining deploy questions, prepares the deploy, asks the deploy question, and on the human's no records nothing, runs no deploy, tells the human the deploy waits for their yes and stops.
expectations: The transcript contains `vecten answer has_warehouse no` and `vecten answer sources "start empty"`, then `vecten init` and `vecten up`
No `vecten connector` command ran and skills/connector/SKILL.md was never dispatched

After `vecten up`, the loop went to the semantic model items: `vecten dbt-build-local` ran for `Build the dbt project locally`, `next` never reported `No metrics defined in osi/metrics.json`, and the agent followed skills/semantic/SKILL.md for `Validate the semantic model` until a `vecten mcp validate` run exited 0, defining no metric, all before the cloud question was asked

The agent recorded `vecten answer cloud none`, then ran `vecten estimate --size small --components platform,mcp --warehouse postgres` and `vecten guide cloud` as the item's `show_first` printed them, showed their output to the human, and asked the cloud question again word for word before recording `vecten answer cloud aws`
`vecten init --deploy`, `vecten github init`, `vecten bootstrap --env prod` and `vecten github push` ran before the deploy question was asked
The agent put the deploy question to the human word for word; after the human's no, `vecten deploy` never ran and no `vecten answer` was recorded for it

The agent told the human that no platform resources were created, since `vecten deploy` never ran (the state bucket and roles `vecten bootstrap` created are not platform resources), and that the deploy waits for their yes, and stopped without running another command
Every ask item the agent put to the human is the item's title, word for word as `vecten next --json` printed it
